instruction: Could you enhance the colors to make my desktop photo look more professional?

metadata.explanation: This task asks for general color enhancement to achieve a 'professional' look. It's infeasible because 'professional' is highly subjective and context-dependent (portrait vs landscape vs product photography require different treatments), and we have no objective metrics to evaluate what constitutes professional-quality color grading.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - the instruction requires subjective aesthetic judgment
The success criteria 'professional look' has no objective definition or measurable metrics
Color enhancement quality is inherently subjective and context-dependent
No combination of getters/metrics can objectively verify if colors appear 'more professional'
The infeasible marker is the appropriate evaluator for this task
